premises.text: Data breaches are common and costly, so encryption is needed to mitigate breach risk
premises.evidence_span: it's no longer a question of whether a breach will occur, but rather what the cost of this breach will be

premises.text: Calypso keeps cloud database data encrypted at rest, in transit, and in memory
premises.evidence_span: the data remains encrypted, addressed, in transit, and in memory at the database storage

premises.text: Users can privately search and fetch encrypted data without revealing keys or changing applications
premises.evidence_span: While encrypted, one is able to search through the data, fetch them back to the application in a private way, and only there the data gets decrypted

premises.text: Oblivious RAM plus differential privacy enables efficient secure indexing on AES-encrypted records
premises.evidence_span: we combine cryptography, so oblivious RAM, with differential privacy in order to ensure an efficient and secure indexing of these records

premises.text: Solution offers true security with much higher speed and broader query support than alternatives
premises.evidence_span: Calypso is the first one to offer this true security with orders of magnitude higher speeds

premises.text: GTM via direct financial-services and cloud-native engagements plus database channel partners
premises.evidence_span: we're working with direct engagements with financial services, medium-sized, cloud-native companies, and also database providers as channel partners

value.text: True cloud data security that lets clients differentiate products while keeping data secret
value.evidence_span: help you differentiate your products for your clients based on true security
